author: Elisheva Wimberly
title: New sports facility could be coming to Franklin - NewsBreak
text:
By Elisheva Wimberly ,
1 days ago
FRANKLIN, Tenn. (WKRN) — A treasured farm in Franklin could soon be transformed into a new sports facility.
The new mixed-use sports facility, “The Banks at Brownland,” is all about improving access for youth sports.
The facility would be located on Brownland Farm on Hillsboro Road near Mack Hatcher Parkway.
Neighborhood News: Stories impacting your community | Read More Brownland Farm has been a longstanding staple in the Franklin community for over 60 years, hosting equestrian events. The current owners are seeking to downsize, and “The Banks at Brownland” could fill the void on the property.
The Banks at Brownland will include a 100,000-square-foot hockey facility with two sheets of ice.
There will also be 11 fields for flag football, soccer and lacrosse.
BanksatBrowlandSitePlan Download The Tennessee Titans and Nashville Soccer Club plan to host youth soccer and football programs once the fields are complete.
Leaders said facilities like this help them train the next generation of athletes and bring more health and wellness opportunities to the community.
Nashville Predators Chief Executive Officer Sean Henry said the vision for The Banks at Brownland goes far beyond athletic facilities, and it helps build community and quality of life for generations to come.
⏩ Read today’s top stories on wkrn.com
The Banks at Brownland will also include retail, restaurants, a grocery store, fitness, medical offices and more.
The City of Franklin still needs to approve the project. If approved, the Nashville Predators will manage the facility. Project leaders hope to break ground sometime next year.
The Williamson County Commission and Franklin’s Board of Mayor and Aldermen will hold a joint meeting on June 29 to discuss co-owning the facility.
